SPSS-Style Descriptives Table (PNG)

spss_descriptives_png.Rd

Saves an SPSS-style descriptives table as a PNG image. Requires the gt package (listed in Suggests).

Usage

spss_descriptives_png(
  data,
  variables,
  filename = "descriptives.png",
  digits = 2,
  width = 7,
  height = NULL,
  dpi = 150
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

variables

Character vector of variable names to summarize.

filename

Character. Output filename (should end in .png).

digits

Integer. Number of decimal places. Default 2.

width

Numeric. Image width in inches. Default 7.

height

Numeric. Image height in inches. Default NULL (auto).

dpi

Numeric. Resolution. Default 150.

Value

The filename (invisibly).
